name: Testim
description_en:
Testim is a product in the Software testing category. Its directory profile covers Bug Tracking, Continuous Integration, Seamless Integration, Test Recorder, Reporting and Analysis, Parallel Testing, Scheduling, Cross Browser Support.

Additional listed capabilities include Parameterized Testing, Debugging, Access Control. These areas should be evaluated against the tasks, permissions and data involved in the intended workflow.

Deployment is listed as Browser Based (Cloud) Mobile App (Android). The listed organization sizes are All (Small, Medium, Large) Individuals. API support is listed as NA. Support channels are listed as 24/7 (Live rep), Online.

The directory's pricing snapshot states: Free Trial Available Offers Free-forever and Custom plan.. This is a dated third-party reference; current amounts, billing periods, trial conditions and regional availability require an official pricing check.

Typical evaluation tasks associated with these feature labels include: record software defects and follow their progress; allocate times for appointments, resources or tasks; work with supported browsers in a common workflow; inspect program execution to investigate faults; restrict information and actions according to permissions. These are workflow suggestions based on the reported capabilities, rather than evidence of actual customer adoption.
description_zh:
Testim 属于软件测试软件。第三方资料列出的功能包括缺陷跟踪、持续集成、集成能力、测试录制工具、报表与分析、并行测试、排程管理、跨浏览器支持。

资料还列出参数化测试、代码调试、访问控制。选择时应结合实际任务、使用权限和数据处理需求逐项评估。

资料所列运行方式为浏览器访问（云服务） 移动应用 (Android)。资料所列适用组织规模为小型、中型与大型组织 个人用户。API 支持情况为未注明。资料所列支持方式为全天候人工支持, 在线支持。

第三方定价快照显示：提供免费试用 另有持续免费方案和定制方案。。这属于采集时的第三方参考，实际金额、计费周期、试用条件及地区可用性仍需核对官网。

根据这些功能，可重点评估以下任务：记录软件缺陷并跟踪处理进展；为预约、资源或任务安排时间；在同一流程中使用受支持的不同浏览器；检查程序执行过程以定位故障；根据权限限制信息访问和操作。这些是基于功能的使用场景建议，不能当作实际客户采用的证据。

research_gaps.en: Pricing distinguishes Web, Mobile and Salesforce; trial falls back to one Community plan per organization with changeable features. Mobile remote capacity/platform purchase is separately qualified. The run-quota guide exempts local editor runs, while local test/suite/plan/CI and grid/scheduler runs count for a Test Runs model. Therefore local is not a blanket zero-quota promise. No account, grid, app upload, device, schedule or test was operated.
research_gaps.zh: 定价区分 Web、Mobile 及 Salesforce；试用后退回每组织一个、功能可变化的 Community。移动端远端容量／平台购买另有限定。运行配额指南豁免本地编辑器运行，但 Test Runs 模型的本地测试／套件／计划／CI 及 grid／调度运行计配额，因此本地不一概等于零配额。本次未操作账户、grid、应用上传、设备、调度或测试。
